activity_summary: At early church Alse showed the band washed white. Mistress Ansell looked at the fold and was satisfied. You did not stay for a sermon in the porch.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the one band and left the sermon unmade.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Checked the fold and took them in.

entities.name: the blue band
entities.context: Mentioned in The band is white

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: It is white, mistress. I washed it before we came.
